title: Christmas is coming!!!
body:
We are fast approaching Advent and Christmas is just round the corner! Throughout the Advent season we have a number of events scheduled. 

To kick off advent we have our Maranatha advent worship and prayer night. We will be out on the streets singing carols and inviting the local community to come to church at Busking carols. We have our annual church family meal Jingle Bell Jolloff AND our spectacular Christmas extravaganza complete with performances and Christingle making. We will also have a contemporary carol service and a Christmas Eve Family cinema night!

During the Advent season on Sunday mornings we will be taking a breath with a more stripped back service, creating space to reflect and focus on Jesus amidst the business of the season.

Please think about where you could could help out and who you are going to invite to come and hear the amazing story of God coming to us as a baby to save the world.
